demo.anya.scope.people.note: Who I spent these three years with.
demo.anya.scope.maxim.note: My boyfriend, a sound engineer. Stayed behind to hand over his studio and fly out after me.
demo.anya.scope.lena.note: A friend, in Belgrade since 2022. Invited me over, gave me her couch, says the true thing out loud.
demo.anya.scope.mama.note: Lives back home, calls on Sundays. Kept Tisha for a year and a half.
demo.anya.scope.jovana.note: My accountant, handles my business and all the paperwork. Knows what you actually need and what “they say in the chat”.
demo.anya.scope.milos.note: My landlord in Vračar. Renews the lease without a fuss.
demo.anya.scope.marko.note: Lena's dentist. The crown in October 2024.
demo.anya.scope.milica.note: A colleague from the new job, since May 2025. My first friend who isn't an expat.
demo.anya.scope.luka.note: An architect from Novi Sad who lives in Zemun. We met at the climbing gym in October 2025.
demo.anya.scope.tisha.note: My cat. Technically not a person.
demo.anya.scope.flat.note: Two rooms in Vračar: third floor, no elevator, a balcony onto a linden tree. Mine since October 1, 2023.
demo.anya.scope.room.note: First it waited for Maxim, then it stood closed, and since January 2025 it's the room for the cat and the desk.
demo.anya.scope.dorcol.note: The old neighborhood by the river: Lena's couch, cafés, Bajloni market, Skadarlija.
demo.anya.scope.savska.note: Savska 35, the police office for foreigners. The white card, the application, the residence cards. The line starts at seven.
demo.anya.scope.apr-bank.note: Where I registered the business and opened an account: the business in a week, the account on the second try.
demo.anya.scope.ada.note: Ada Ciganlija, the city lake. Cold water in May, warm in July.
demo.anya.scope.nbg.note: New Belgrade: concrete blocks across the river, the office and the climbing gym.
demo.anya.scope.office.note: The new job's office, two days a week since May 2025.
demo.anya.scope.gym.note: The climbing gym, Tuesdays and Thursdays since October 2025.
demo.anya.scope.zemun.note: The old town across the river: Gardoš, Luka.
demo.anya.scope.hikes.note: Hikes with the club: Avala, Kosmaj, Fruška Gora, Tara.
demo.anya.scope.mama-home.note: The home I left. I went back once, for New Year 2025.
demo.anya.scope.tbilisi.note: A week in October 2025, to check whether I'd be better off there.
demo.anya.scope.affairs.note: The lines my life runs along.
demo.anya.scope.legal.note: Documents: the white card, the business, the account, the application, the residence card, renewals, permanent residence.
demo.anya.scope.money.note: Money: a 1,050 salary plus 500 from Maxim, then minus 400, then my own.
demo.anya.scope.work.note: Working as a QA tester: remote, then with an office, then automation.
demo.anya.scope.desk.note: The desk in the second room: linocuts, postcards, markets since January 2025.
demo.anya.scope.serbian.note: Serbian: a course I dropped, slava at Luka's, the bank in Serbian.
demo.anya.scope.next.note: Where next: the Spanish threshold, Tbilisi, “not for good”.
demo.anya.period.2023: The year I went first: the decision in May, Belgrade in September, December 12 without Maxim.
demo.anya.period.2024: The year of waiting. The card, the heat, the tooth, the fight, and at the end a talk in Mom's kitchen.
demo.anya.period.2025: The year life became my own: the cat, the desk, a new job, the climbing gym, Luka.
demo.anya.period.2023-05: We decided to go: me first, Maxim three months later.
demo.anya.period.2023-09: The first month: Lena's couch, the white card on the second try, the business in a week. The city is golden.
demo.anya.period.2023-10: An apartment for two and the first 500 from Maxim. A visa run to Višegrad, the bank on the second try.
demo.anya.period.2023-11: Rain and paperwork: I applied for residence. Maxim confirmed the 12th but didn't buy a ticket.
demo.anya.period.2023-12: Dark from four, smog. On the 12th Maxim didn't come. New Year at Lena's.
demo.anya.period.2024-01: A gray January. The flat-rate tax every month, and “after the holidays” turned into “in the spring”.
demo.anya.period.2024-03: I'm thirty, the residence card is in my hands, spring came in a single day. “In the spring” turned into “in the summer”.
demo.anya.period.2024-07: Heat near forty, the second room closed. Maxim promises September, for sure.
demo.anya.period.2024-09: A year in Belgrade, no Maxim. Getting Tisha ready for Maxim to bring him at New Year.
demo.anya.period.2024-10: A broken tooth, a crown for a month's rent, 700 from him on top. Looked at Spain and closed the tab.
demo.anya.period.2024-11: The second dark November. “I'm the one giving you money.” Lena said out loud what I hadn't.
demo.anya.period.2024-12: A ticket home, papers for the cat. I flew in, and on the thirtieth we had the talk.
demo.anya.period.2025-01: Tisha is home, on the radiator. The second room became the room for the cat and the desk. A CV.
demo.anya.period.2025-02: “Don't send any more.” The first month on my own: minus 400.
demo.anya.period.2025-05: The first salary at the new job, an office in New Belgrade, my first market. Plus 300.
demo.anya.period.2025-10: The climbing gym, Avala, Luka. A week in Tbilisi and the answer: here.
demo.anya.period.2025-12: Sixty prints on order. New Year at my place.
demo.anya.period.2026-01: Slava at Luka's parents' in Novi Sad.
demo.anya.period.2026-03: Residence for three years. Moved to automation.
demo.anya.period.2026-05: Mom spent two weeks in the second room. Her parting words: “well, live, then”.
demo.anya.period.2026-08: My first workshop. The bank in Serbian. Luka asks me to move to Zemun.
demo.anya.period.2026-09: Three years. 3,000 in savings, permanent residence papers ahead.
demo.anya.trace.pay-abroad: My salary goes to someone else's account
demo.anya.trace.pay-abroad.desc: For the second year the company pays remote staff in euros to a foreign account, and I still don't have one. I get it through friends of friends, minus a cut every month.
demo.anya.trace.lena-3: Lena asks me to Belgrade for the third time
demo.anya.trace.lena-3.desc: Lena's a friend, she's lived there since 2022. She writes: it's warm, no visa, the language is almost ours, come. This time I showed the message to Maxim.
demo.anya.trace.we-decided: Decided: I go first, Maxim three months later
demo.anya.trace.we-decided.desc: Maxim and I sat down and did the math. His recording studio can't be handed over in a month. I rent us an apartment and do the papers, he hands over the studio and flies out after me.
demo.anya.trace.plan-move.desc: I can't make it sooner: work, documents, the cat.
demo.anya.trace.plan-vnz.desc: Temporary residence, the permit to live there. I want the papers ready by the time Maxim arrives.
demo.anya.trace.jovana-contact: Lena gave me an accountant's contact, Jovana
demo.anya.trace.jovana-contact.desc: Jovana runs the books for half of Lena's friends. She sent a two-page list of documents.
demo.anya.trace.ticket: One way. Didn't buy a return.
demo.anya.trace.tisha-mama: Took Tisha to Mom's for three months
demo.anya.trace.tisha-mama.desc: Tisha's my cat. Until we have an apartment, he's better off at Mom's. Mom said “uh-huh”.
demo.anya.trace.maxim-dec12.desc: He'll sell the car, hand over the studio, buy the ticket in November. I'm writing it down as a date, not as a hope.
demo.anya.trace.goodbye: The last evening before I fly
demo.anya.trace.goodbye.desc: Maxim went over the plan again: the car, the studio, December 12. Walked me to the taxi and said three months is nothing.
demo.anya.trace.arrive.desc: Saturday, 27°C. Lena met me. I'm on her couch in Dorćol until I find an apartment for Maxim and me.
demo.anya.trace.get-vnz.desc: Without it I have to leave after thirty days. Jovana's plan: the white card, the business, the account, the application, and visa runs while all that goes on.
demo.anya.trace.step-card: Get the white card within a day
demo.anya.trace.step-card.desc: The white card is the police registration at your address. You have to register within the first day, and without the card you can't file anything else.
demo.anya.trace.card-refuse: White card: the owner of Lena's apartment said no
demo.anya.trace.card-refuse.desc: He doesn't want trouble with the tax office. The first hostel said no too. My day runs out tomorrow morning.
demo.anya.trace.card-hostel: You pay for a night you don't sleep there and get the white card. 2,000 dinars is about 17 €.
demo.anya.trace.menjacnica: Living on cash: the menjačnica on the corner
demo.anya.trace.menjacnica.desc: A menjačnica is an exchange office. My Russian card doesn't work here, so I change euros for cash. Every street has its own rate; I've memorized the three exchange offices with the best one.
demo.anya.trace.jovana-first: Jovana: the business first, without it no account and no residence
demo.anya.trace.jovana-first.desc: A sole proprietorship on the flat-rate tax: you pay a fixed amount every month and count nothing. The name follows the template “first name last name PR Beograd”.
demo.anya.trace.call-1: We call every evening. I showed him Dorćol from Lena's balcony.
demo.anya.trace.apr-submit: APR is the agency where businesses get registered. They took my papers on the first try, decision in a week.
demo.anya.trace.golden: Belgrade in September: the city is golden
demo.anya.trace.golden.desc: Cafés outside until late at night, and everyone smokes inside. Everybody says “polako”, “take it slow”. So far it sounds sweet.
demo.anya.trace.ip-decision.desc: The decision from APR came in a week. I'm an entrepreneur now.
demo.anya.trace.call-2: Told him about the business. He laughed at “PR Beograd”.
demo.anya.trace.flat: Rented two rooms in Vračar, for the two of us
demo.anya.trace.flat.desc: Third floor, no elevator, a balcony onto a linden tree. 550 € instead of 400 for a one-room: there'll be two of us, after all. The landlord, Miloš, took a month in advance and a deposit.
demo.anya.trace.deposit: Almost everything I brought. After this, 550 a month plus utilities.
demo.anya.trace.room-empty: The second room is empty. It's his
demo.anya.trace.room-empty.desc: We'll buy the furniture together when he comes. For now I've closed the door.
demo.anya.trace.transfer-1: The first 500 from Maxim. We agreed he sends rent money until he comes. With it, my numbers add up.
demo.anya.trace.step-visarun: A visa run before the thirty days are up
demo.anya.trace.step-visarun.desc: Without residence you can stay thirty days. Then you leave Serbia and come back in, and the count starts over.
demo.anya.trace.visegrad.desc: Three hours by bus to Bosnia. The bridge, an exit stamp, an entry stamp, back again. Thirty days from scratch.
demo.anya.trace.bank-refuse: They don't open accounts for a foreigner without residence, come back with the card. And they won't give me the card without an account.
demo.anya.trace.call-3: After the bank said no. He said: you'll figure it out, you always do.
demo.anya.trace.apostille-panic: Panic: the chat says I need an apostille on my diploma
demo.anya.trace.apostille-panic.desc: The diploma is at Mom's, and an apostille in Moscow takes a month. I sit and count whether I'll make it before I apply.
demo.anya.trace.bank-ok: Poštanska štedionica: two hours in line, opened with no questions. My salary now lands in my own account, no friends taking a cut.
demo.anya.trace.apostille-no.desc: A copy or a statement is enough. A week of panic because of the chat. Lesson: ask Jovana, not the chat.
demo.anya.trace.card2: A new white card, this time for Vračar; Miloš came with me. Savska 35, the police office for foreigners, which is also where you apply for residence.
demo.anya.trace.call-4: About the white card. He asked how big the second room is.
demo.anya.trace.rain.desc: The linden has lost its leaves, the balcony is wet. I work from the kitchen.
demo.anya.trace.bar: Second visa run: Bar, the sea
demo.anya.trace.bar.desc: By bus to Montenegro, a night in empty November Bar. The sea is gray, nobody around. Took a photo for us, to show Maxim.
demo.anya.trace.call-5: Sent him the sea from Bar. He said we'll go together in the summer.
demo.anya.trace.submit: Applied for residence. A line from seven in the morning, two and a half hours. A decision within sixty days, they'll call.
demo.anya.trace.wait.desc: Up to sixty days. While they review it, no visa runs needed.
demo.anya.trace.call-6: He's at the studio, we talked on the go.
demo.anya.trace.maxim-confirm.desc: I asked him straight. He said it's still on, the studio is almost handed over.
demo.anya.trace.calls-twice: We only call twice a week now
demo.anya.trace.calls-twice.desc: In September we talked every day. Now he spends evenings at the studio finishing orders before the handover.
demo.anya.trace.no-ticket: Maxim still hasn't bought a ticket
demo.anya.trace.no-ticket.desc: He says prices keep jumping, he'll get one in a few days. He meant to buy it in November.
demo.anya.trace.key: Had a key to the apartment made for him. Hung it on the hook by the door.
demo.anya.trace.dark.desc: By half past four it's night. I only leave the house to go to the store.
demo.anya.trace.maxim-after: Maxim: not coming on the 12th, now it's “after the holidays”
demo.anya.trace.maxim-after.desc: He called in the evening. He still hasn't handed over the studio, the buyer is stalling. No ticket. I asked when, he said after the holidays.
demo.anya.trace.maxim-jan.desc: No date. “In January, as soon as the studio's off my hands.”
demo.anya.trace.dec12.desc: He was supposed to fly in today. An ordinary workday, three calls. In the evening I opened the door to the second room and closed it again.
demo.anya.trace.call-7: Him at the studio, someone playing in the background.
demo.anya.trace.smog.desc: In winter the houses burn wood in their stoves, and smoke hangs over the city. I air the place out at night.
demo.anya.trace.ny-lena.desc: Nine people at the table, all of them arrived in the last year. Nobody knows where they'll be in six months. When they asked about Maxim, I said: mine's coming in the spring.
demo.anya.trace.pausal: Paušal is the business's flat-rate tax; the bill arrives every month. Jovana: that's the whole tax, nothing else to pay.
demo.anya.trace.maxim-spring: Maxim: “after the holidays” is now “in the spring”
demo.anya.trace.maxim-spring.desc: The studio still isn't sold. We didn't talk about a ticket.
demo.anya.trace.maxim-spring-i.desc: No date. Spring is March, April or May.
demo.anya.trace.ny-plateau: Nothing happens, and it turns out that's normal
demo.anya.trace.ny-plateau.desc: Gray. Work, calls, testing releases. Waiting for the residence decision and waiting for Maxim, and neither one is up to me.
demo.anya.trace.call-8: Longer than usual: there's a buyer for the studio.
demo.anya.trace.decision-call: Savska called: the residence decision is ready
demo.anya.trace.decision-call.desc: A hundred and four days after applying instead of sixty. Pick up the card in March.
demo.anya.trace.bday30.desc: Maxim sent me his studio headphones by courier. Celebrated with Lena and two girls from the expat chat at a kafana in Skadarlija. A kafana is a Serbian tavern.
demo.anya.trace.card: Picked up the card: residence for a year. “By December” didn't happen; it happened by March.
demo.anya.trace.renew-hint: Jovana: start the renewal two months ahead
demo.anya.trace.renew-hint.desc: The card is good until March 10, 2025. So in January it's back to Savska.
demo.anya.trace.renew-1.desc: Two months before the card runs out, like Jovana said.
demo.anya.trace.spring: Spring came in a single day
demo.anya.trace.spring.desc: Yesterday a jacket, today tables outside and snowdrops in Tašmajdan park.
demo.anya.trace.call-9: The studio buyer fell through. Spring is unlikely, he says.
demo.anya.trace.maxim-summer: Maxim: “in the spring” is now “in the summer”
demo.anya.trace.maxim-summer.desc: He needs a new buyer for the studio. I didn't argue.
demo.anya.trace.maxim-summer-i.desc: No date, same as last time.
demo.anya.trace.course: Go to a Serbian course on Wednesdays
demo.anya.trace.course.desc: Five months, until the end of August. Without the language I'm a guest here forever.
demo.anya.trace.course-1.desc: I understand half. False friends at every step: “pozorište” is a theater, though to a Russian ear it sounds like “disgrace”.
demo.anya.trace.call-10: The calls keep getting shorter. He's tired, so am I.
demo.anya.trace.serbian-fail: Called the insurance company in Serbian and gave up
demo.anya.trace.serbian-fail.desc: By the third sentence I'd switched to English. The woman on the other end seemed relieved.
demo.anya.trace.ada-1: First time at Ada: the water's still cold
demo.anya.trace.ada-1.desc: Ada Ciganlija is a lake in Belgrade, and in summer the whole city is there. I went in up to my knees.
demo.anya.trace.heat.desc: No air conditioning. A fan during the day, at night I sleep on the balcony.
demo.anya.trace.room-closed: Closed the second room so it doesn't heat up
demo.anya.trace.room-closed.desc: Nobody's in there anyway. The key I had made for Maxim hangs on the hook by the door.
demo.anya.trace.maxim-sept: Maxim: “in September, for the anniversary, for sure”
demo.anya.trace.maxim-sept.desc: September 9 is a year since I got here. He promised to buy the ticket in August.
demo.anya.trace.maxim-sept-i: Maxim arrives September 9, for the anniversary
demo.anya.trace.maxim-sept-i.desc: An exact date again, the first since December.
demo.anya.trace.course-drop.desc: The heat, half the group has left town. Told myself I'll pick it up in the fall.
demo.anya.trace.few-notes: A summer with almost no entries
demo.anya.trace.few-notes.desc: Leafing through the notebook: three lines each for July and August. The heat, the closed room, the dropped course. At least I'm writing that down.
demo.anya.trace.anniv-1: A year in Belgrade. Maxim didn't come
demo.anya.trace.anniv-1.desc: He texted in the morning: “September didn't work out, let's do New Year”. I celebrated alone, on the balcony.
demo.anya.trace.maxim-ny-i.desc: The sixth date since last summer. I'm writing this one down too.
demo.anya.trace.tisha-plan: Maxim will bring Tisha at New Year
demo.anya.trace.tisha-plan.desc: If he's flying, he can fly with the cat. To take a cat out of the country you need a microchip, a vaccination and a blood test.
demo.anya.trace.step-chip: Ask Mom to get Tisha chipped and vaccinated
demo.anya.trace.step-chip.desc: Without a chip they won't let the cat out.
demo.anya.trace.chip-done: Mom took Tisha in: chip and vaccination
demo.anya.trace.chip-done.desc: She sent a photo: Tisha in the carrier with an offended face.
demo.anya.trace.step-blood: Get Tisha's blood tested for antibodies
demo.anya.trace.step-blood.desc: No earlier than a month after the vaccination.
demo.anya.trace.call-12: Told him about the chip. He said: “we'll see”.
demo.anya.trace.autumn2: The second fall, not new anymore
demo.anya.trace.autumn2.desc: The same chestnuts, the same cafés outside. A year ago the city was golden, now it's just the city.
demo.anya.trace.tooth: Broke a tooth on a walnut from Bajloni
demo.anya.trace.tooth.desc: Bajloni is the market in Dorćol, it has the best nuts. A crunch, and half the tooth is gone.
demo.anya.trace.marko: 84,000 dinars is about 720 €. Almost a month's rent with utilities.
demo.anya.trace.blood-done: Mom: Tisha's blood test is done
demo.anya.trace.blood-done.desc: The vet said he can travel in three months. Just in time for New Year.
demo.anya.trace.pasha: Pasha from the chat left for Spain
demo.anya.trace.pasha.desc: On a digital nomad visa. I spent the whole evening reading how he got it.
demo.anya.trace.threshold: Looked up the Spanish visa: the threshold is 2,850 € a month
demo.anya.trace.not-final.desc: Not a plan, a caveat. No date.
demo.anya.trace.call-13: We call once a week now. He didn't ask about the tooth.
demo.anya.trace.count.desc: A 1,050 salary plus 500 from Maxim. Without his 500 I'm 400 short every month. I'm living on his money.
demo.anya.trace.transfer-700: On top of the usual 500, “for the tooth”. I didn't ask.
demo.anya.trace.dark2.desc: My second November here. Last year it was new.
demo.anya.trace.room-storage: The second room became a storeroom
demo.anya.trace.room-storage.desc: Put the boxes of summer clothes in there. There's nothing else in it.
demo.anya.trace.fight: We had a fight. He wants me to come back “at least for the winter”, I don't want to. He said: “I'm the one giving you money.” I wrote it down word for word.
demo.anya.trace.lena-says.desc: She said it at Bajloni, between the nuts and the cheese. I said: he's coming for New Year.
demo.anya.trace.come-you.desc: Not “I'll come”, but “you come here”. For New Year, back home.
demo.anya.trace.call-14: About dates. He said he'll pick me up if I fly in.
demo.anya.trace.ticket-home: Flying home for New Year. If he won't come here, I'll go there.
demo.anya.trace.papers-q: Asked Mom if Tisha's papers are ready
demo.anya.trace.papers-q.desc: If I'm flying home, I can bring the cat back myself.
demo.anya.trace.smog2.desc: A year ago on December 12 I was waiting for Maxim. Today it's just smog.
demo.anya.trace.call-15: Seven minutes: agreed where to meet at the airport.
demo.anya.trace.fly-home.desc: The first time I've seen him in a year and three months. In the car we talked about the road.
demo.anya.trace.talk: The talk with Maxim: he's not coming
demo.anya.trace.talk.desc: We sat in the kitchen until two in the morning. He's not coming. He said: come back. I said: no.
demo.anya.trace.ny-mama.desc: The three of us: Mom, me and Tisha. Mom didn't ask about Maxim, and I didn't tell her.
demo.anya.trace.mama-cat.desc: The papers have been ready since the fall. I thought Maxim would bring him. I'll bring him.
demo.anya.trace.vet-export: The last paper for the cat, forty minutes.
demo.anya.trace.tisha-home: Flew back to Belgrade with Tisha
demo.anya.trace.tisha-home.desc: A taxi from Nikola Tesla Airport, Tisha silent in his carrier the whole way. At home he sniffed both rooms and lay down on the radiator in the small one.
demo.anya.trace.transfer-16: Came on the fifth, as always. Out of habit.
demo.anya.trace.daily-cat: First work call with a cat on the keyboard
demo.anya.trace.daily-cat.desc: The team's morning stand-up. Tisha walked across the keys, and the team saw a tail.
demo.anya.trace.desk: I want to make something with my hands. Linocut: you carve a picture into linoleum and print from it.
demo.anya.trace.room-cat: The second room is now for the cat and the desk
demo.anya.trace.room-cat.desc: Moved the boxes to the balcony, I don't close the door anymore. Maxim's key is still on the hook; I can't take it down yet.
demo.anya.trace.cv.desc: Without his 500 I need a bigger salary.
demo.anya.trace.find-job: Find a job paying 1,500 € or more by the end of April
demo.anya.trace.find-job.desc: 1,500, so I can live without someone else's money.
demo.anya.trace.stop-money: Wrote to Maxim: don't send any more
demo.anya.trace.stop-money.desc: Five hundred a month is the last thread. Let that go too.
demo.anya.trace.off-500: Cover the minus 400 myself until the new salary
demo.anya.trace.off-500.desc: From my savings and from what I earn on my own.
demo.anya.trace.renew-submit: Applied to renew my residence. Jovana put the package together.
demo.anya.trace.net: Third floor, and Tisha watches the birds in the linden. Put up a net.
demo.anya.trace.interviews.desc: Two in English, one at a Serbian company.
demo.anya.trace.minus-400.desc: The first month without Maxim's 500. The first time I'm counting for myself, not for him.
demo.anya.trace.bday31.desc: Lena, a kafana, and that's it. It was enough.
demo.anya.trace.cards: The first money from the desk. Sold linocut postcards in the expat chat: the Temple, Gardoš, the bridge at Višegrad.
demo.anya.trace.minus-250.desc: The postcards plugged part of the hole.
demo.anya.trace.renew-2.desc: The card is good until March 2026, start two months ahead.
demo.anya.trace.offer: An offer: QA tester at an office in New Belgrade, 1,600 €
demo.anya.trace.offer.desc: Two days a week at the office. I keep the business, I'm a contractor.
demo.anya.trace.minus-100.desc: The last month on the old salary.
demo.anya.trace.salary-1: First salary at the new job: 1,600 €
demo.anya.trace.salary-1.desc: That's 1,050 plus Maxim's 500, only now it's all mine.
demo.anya.trace.office-1: First day at the office in New Belgrade
demo.anya.trace.office-1.desc: New Belgrade is a city of concrete blocks across the river, nothing like Dorćol. Milica from the team asked me to lunch; the team lead is Serbian.
demo.anya.trace.market-1: My first market, at Dorćol Platz. Sold forty prints.
demo.anya.trace.plus-300.desc: The first month in the black since the move.
demo.anya.trace.autotests: Take a test automation course in the evenings
demo.anya.trace.autotests.desc: Enough testing by hand, I want to move into automation.
demo.anya.trace.cafe-series: The café where I work on my laptop asked for a series for their walls.
demo.anya.trace.bug: Let a bug slip into a release
demo.anya.trace.bug.desc: A post-mortem with the whole team. Embarrassing. My first crisis here that isn't about papers but about work.
demo.anya.trace.ac: The second summer near forty. No more sleeping on the balcony.
demo.anya.trace.maxim-msg: Maxim wrote, asked about the cat
demo.anya.trace.maxim-msg.desc: The first message in six months. I answered: all good.
demo.anya.trace.ada-milica.desc: The water's warm. Milica teaches me Serbian words that aren't in the textbook.
demo.anya.trace.insta: Started an Instagram for the postcards
demo.anya.trace.insta.desc: Buyers from the chat keep asking to see everything at once.
demo.anya.trace.anniv-2.desc: Dinner with Lena and Milica. No looking back, just dinner.
demo.anya.trace.course-done.desc: Four months of evenings. Sent the certificate to my team lead.
demo.anya.trace.tbilisi-i: Go to Tbilisi for a week, to check
demo.anya.trace.tbilisi-i.desc: Half the expat chat has moved there. I'll see whether I'd be better off there.
demo.anya.trace.gym: Go climbing on Tuesdays and Thursdays
demo.anya.trace.gym-1: First time at the climbing gym
demo.anya.trace.gym-1.desc: A climbing gym in New Belgrade, next to the office. Made it halfway up the easiest route.
demo.anya.trace.avala.desc: Avala is a mountain on the edge of Belgrade. Twenty people, half of them Serbs.
demo.anya.trace.luka: Met Luka at the climbing gym
demo.anya.trace.luka.desc: An architect from Novi Sad who lives in Zemun. Told me where to put my foot.
demo.anya.trace.tisha-lena: Tisha at Lena's for a week
demo.anya.trace.tbilisi.desc: I liked it. It's cheaper, and half the chat is already there.
demo.anya.trace.tbilisi-back: Back from Tbilisi: I'm staying here
demo.anya.trace.tbilisi-back.desc: It's nice there, but too much here is mine: the apartment, the desk, the climbing gym, Tisha.
demo.anya.trace.kosmaj.desc: A mountain south of Belgrade. Luka came too.
demo.anya.trace.sofa: The first big thing for this apartment. I picked it out alone, for myself.
demo.anya.trace.zemun-walk.desc: Zemun is the old town across the river; Luka has an apartment there. We climbed Gardoš, and he showed me the town in layers: this is Austrian, this is Serbian, this is his.
demo.anya.trace.market-2: My second market. People asked for postcards of Zemun.
demo.anya.trace.renew-2-note: Jovana: we start the second renewal in January
demo.anya.trace.gym-2: Luka belays me at the climbing gym now
demo.anya.trace.gym-2.desc: Belaying means he holds the rope while I climb.
demo.anya.trace.corp-order: An order from an expat company for gifts to their staff. The desk's best month.
demo.anya.trace.ny-mine.desc: Lena, Milica, two people from the climbing gym, and Luka came after midnight. Nobody at the table says “for now”.
demo.anya.trace.renew-start: Jovana put together the renewal package
demo.anya.trace.slava: Slava at Luka's parents' in Novi Sad
demo.anya.trace.slava.desc: Slava is a family's feast of its patron saint; theirs is Sveti Jovan. My first time with a Serbian family, I understand two thirds.
demo.anya.trace.renew-submit-2: The second renewal. Same line, from seven in the morning.
demo.anya.trace.wrist: Sprained my wrist at the climbing gym
demo.anya.trace.physio: Three weeks with no linocuts and no climbing.
demo.anya.trace.bday32.desc: Lena and Luka in the same company for the first time. They got along.
demo.anya.trace.mama-visit-i: Mom is coming for two weeks
demo.anya.trace.mama-visit-i.desc: Her first visit to me. I bought her ticket.
demo.anya.trace.fruska.desc: Hills and monasteries outside Novi Sad.
demo.anya.trace.mama-visit: Mom stays with me for two weeks
demo.anya.trace.mama-visit.desc: She sleeps in the second room, between the linocut press and Tisha.
demo.anya.trace.key-mama: Mom took the key off the hook
demo.anya.trace.key-mama.desc: The same copy I had made for Maxim in November 2023. It hung there for two and a half years. Now it's Mom who opens the door with it.
demo.anya.trace.mama-luka.desc: Dinner at my place. Mom spoke Russian, Luka spoke Serbian, and they understood each other.
demo.anya.trace.mama-verdict.desc: She hung the key back on the hook: let it stay there, I'll come in the spring.
demo.anya.trace.ada-26.desc: I know by now where it's shallow, where there's shade and where the best burek is.
demo.anya.trace.tara: Tara with the club, four days
demo.anya.trace.tara.desc: A national park in western Serbia. Luka came too.
demo.anya.trace.bank-serbian: Called the bank in Serbian and didn't switch to English
demo.anya.trace.bank-serbian.desc: I only noticed afterwards, because I remember the insurance call in 2024.
demo.anya.trace.workshop-1: My first workshop, at a coworking space in Dorćol. Eight people came.
demo.anya.trace.luka-zemun: Luka: “move in with me in Zemun”
demo.anya.trace.luka-zemun.desc: I answered with conditions: two rooms, the cat, the press. That's not a “no”.
demo.anya.trace.zemun-q: Move in with Luka in Zemun?
demo.anya.trace.zemun-q.desc: If we find a place with room for two rooms, the cat and the press. No date.
demo.anya.trace.anniv-3.desc: 3,000 € in savings. The apartment is mine, the job is mine, the people around me are mine.
demo.anya.trace.workshop-2.desc: Twelve people have signed up already.
demo.anya.trace.crown-check: Show the crown to Dr. Marko
demo.anya.trace.crown-check.desc: Two years since that crown. You're supposed to get it checked once a year.
demo.anya.trace.market-3.desc: Working on a series of postcards with Zemun.
demo.anya.trace.pmz: Gather the permanent residence documents by the end of November
demo.anya.trace.pmz.desc: Permanent residence, the permit to stay for good. Jovana says you can apply after three years of temporary residence.
demo.anya.trace.pmz-list: Get the permanent residence document list from Jovana
demo.anya.trace.pmz-cert: Collect the certificates and translations for permanent residence
demo.anya.trace.mama-next: Mom will come in the spring
demo.anya.trace.mama-next.desc: She said so as she left. The key is waiting on the hook.
demo.anya.trace.start.desc: This is my notebook: three years in Belgrade, from May 2023, when Maxim and I decided I'd go first, up to today. Every entry knows what it belongs to, a person, a place or a matter, so follow the links. Above the axis are the chapters: pick a chapter or one of its stages and the rows line up by what mattered then. The periods hold my notes on how a month or a year went. Below, under the links, are six entries that make a good place to start.
demo.anya.value.ticket.what: a ticket to Belgrade for September 9
demo.anya.value.deposit.what: a month in advance and a deposit
demo.anya.value.desk.what: a desk and a linocut kit
demo.anya.value.cafe-series.what: a series for a café in Dorćol
demo.anya.chapter.before.note: Spring and summer 2023. Maxim and I decided to go separately: me first, him three months later. Everything I wrote down back then was plans for two.
demo.anya.stage.before.decision.note: May 2023: a salary through other people's hands, Lena's third letter and the evening Maxim and I decided to go separately. Here it's still “we”.
demo.anya.stage.before.packing.note: A summer of packing: the accountant, the document list, a one-way ticket, the cat to Mom's. And December 12, which I wrote down as a fact.
demo.anya.chapter.adaptation.note: For the first four months I lived for two: an apartment for two, a budget for two, a closed door to the second room. The papers went faster than I'd feared: the white card, the business, the account, the application. And December 12 turned out to be an ordinary Tuesday.
demo.anya.stage.adaptation.sofa.note: Three weeks on Lena's couch. The white card, the exchange office, the business: learning to live on cash and on a foreign country's paperwork. The city is golden.
demo.anya.stage.adaptation.flat.note: My own two rooms, but for two: the second room waits for Maxim, his 500 € arrives on the fifth. A visa run and the bank: the papers go faster than I'd feared.
demo.anya.stage.adaptation.wait.note: I've applied for residence and I'm waiting on two decisions at once, from Savska and from Maxim. Watch the calls get shorter and December 12 arrive as an ordinary Tuesday.
demo.anya.chapter.plateau.note: Until September 2024 nothing happened, and I called that normal. The papers were done, the card was in my hands, and every time Maxim's arrival slid by a season.
demo.anya.stage.plateau.hundred.note: A hundred days of waiting for the residence decision. “After the holidays” becomes “in the spring”, and I call it normal.
demo.anya.stage.plateau.card.note: I'm thirty, I have a residence card, and spring came in a day. Maxim's arrival slides to the summer now; I sign up for a Serbian course.
demo.anya.stage.plateau.closed.note: The heat and the closed second room. The course dropped, fewer and fewer entries, and that's an entry too.
demo.anya.chapter.depression.note: Fall 2024. The anniversary without Maxim, a broken tooth, and I finally worked out that I was living on his money. After the fight Lena said out loud what I hadn't said to myself.
demo.anya.stage.depression.autumn.note: The anniversary without Maxim. I'm getting Tisha ready for Maxim to bring him at New Year, as if he's coming.
demo.anya.stage.depression.tooth.note: A broken tooth turns into a reckoning: without his 500 I'm short every month. For the first time I look at where to go next, and close the tab.
demo.anya.stage.depression.fight.note: A fight on the phone: “I'm the one giving you money.” A week later Lena says out loud that he isn't coming.
demo.anya.stage.depression.ticket.note: If he won't come here, I'll fly there. A ticket home and papers for the cat: I won't be flying back alone.
demo.anya.chapter.catharsis.note: A week at the turn of the year: I flew home, we talked, and I came back to Belgrade with the cat, not with Maxim.
demo.anya.stage.catharsis.home.note: At Mom's, Maxim meets me at the airport. For three days we pretend everything is the way it was.
demo.anya.stage.catharsis.talk.note: A talk in the kitchen until two in the morning. He won't come, I won't go back: what stayed open for a year and a half closes.
demo.anya.stage.catharsis.tisha.note: Back to Belgrade with the cat. The second room stops being his: now it's Tisha's and the desk's.
demo.anya.chapter.own.note: Everything after February 2025: without his money, with a new job, the desk, the climbing gym, Luka. A life I choose myself.
demo.anya.stage.own.run.note: Without his money: minus 400, interviews, rejections, the first postcards. In the spring an offer, and in May the first plus.
demo.anya.stage.own.wide.note: Life widens: the climbing gym, hikes, Luka. A week in Tbilisi as a test, and the answer is “here”.
demo.anya.stage.own.steady.note: A card for three years, automation, Mom in the second room, the key on the hook. Permanent residence ahead, and Zemun, no date yet.
